about_short_description.short_description: Mruna is a consulting company that specializes in the distribution and sale of services and products contributing to urban resilience.

product.name: BiomWeb
product.description: A decentralized network of nature-based wastewater treatment systems that are remotely monitored and require minimal operational maintenance.

product.name: BiomPod
product.description: A system that uses natural processes to treat wastewater, minimizing maintenance and operational costs without the use of chemicals.

product.name: BiomPortal
product.description: A suite of sensors and software for monitoring and controlling the BiomWeb system, essential for diagnosing problems and automating control.

product.name: Sustainable Network Infrastructure Planning (SNIP)
product.description: Assesses infrastructure against alternative solutions and ownership structures to establish optimal centralization degree based on cost-benefit.

product.name: Independent Commissioning
product.description: Provides an unbiased perspective of the commissioning process to ensure the project's core design is preserved.

product.name: Global Strategic Review
product.description: Offers a strategic review of business development opportunities and insights into negotiations for power and wastewater plant acquisition and development.
